name: Symrise AG
tagline: Global leader in fragrances, flavorings, cosmetic active ingredients and functional ingredients
hero_kpi_rationale: La croissance organique de 11,5% au H1 2024 démontre la force intrinsèque du modèle économique de Symrise, indépendamment des effets de change et de portefeuille, reflétant une demande robuste dans ses deux segments clés (Taste, Nutrition & Health et Scent & Care) et une stratégie de marché bien exécutée.

kpis.explanation: Increase in revenue excluding foreign exchange and portfolio effects, representing underlying business momentum.
kpis.signal: Solid organic growth across both segments, demonstrating strong underlying demand.
kpis.description: Organic sales growth reached 11.5% in H1 2024, driven by both Taste, Nutrition & Health and Scent & Care segments.

kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated by the company over a given period.
kpis.signal: Revenue growth sustained despite negative FX headwinds.
kpis.description: Sales reached €2,565 million in H1 2024, up 6.3% from €2,414 million in H1 2023.

kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization as a percentage of sales.
kpis.signal: Strong margin expansion driven by lower raw material costs and rigorous cost management.
kpis.description: EBITDA margin reached 20.7% in H1 2024, up from 19.7% adjusted in H1 2023, reflecting improved operational profitability.

kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization.
kpis.signal: EBITDA growth outpacing sales growth, indicating operating leverage.
kpis.description: EBITDA amounted to €530 million in H1 2024, up 11.5% from €475 million adjusted in H1 2023.

kpis.signal: Operating profit growth exceeding sales growth, demonstrating strong operational execution.
kpis.description: EBIT reached €365.8 million in H1 2024, up 10.4% from €331.4 million adjusted in H1 2023.

kpis.explanation: Final profit after all charges and taxes.
kpis.signal: Strong net income growth reflecting improved operational and financial performance.
kpis.description: Net income attributable to shareholders reached €239 million in H1 2024, up 27.7% from €187.5 million in H1 2023.

kpis.explanation: Amount invested in research and development activities.
kpis.signal: Modest R&D investment growth, consistent with product innovation strategy.
kpis.description: R&D expenses amounted to €135.1 million in H1 2024, up 3.2% from €131.0 million in H1 2023.

kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to maintain or expand operations.
kpis.signal: Capex reduction reflecting optimized investment cycle and capital efficiency.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures totaled €91.7 million in H1 2024, down 5.0% from €96.5 million in H1 2023.

kpis.explanation: Total number of full-time equivalent employees.
kpis.signal: Modest workforce growth indicating organizational stability and controlled expansion.
kpis.description: Total headcount reached 12,538 FTE as of June 30, 2024, up 1.0% from 12,435 FTE at December 31, 2023.

kpis.explanation: Measure of financial leverage, calculated as net debt divided by annualized EBITDA.
kpis.signal: Improved leverage ratio indicating strengthened financial position and debt reduction.
kpis.description: Net debt to EBITDA ratio (including lease obligations) decreased to 2.3x as of June 30, 2024, from 2.4x at December 31, 2023.

kpis.explanation: Equity as a percentage of total assets, indicating financial stability.
kpis.signal: Improving equity ratio reflecting strengthened balance sheet and capital base.
kpis.description: Equity ratio improved to 48.2% as of June 30, 2024, from 47.0% at December 31, 2023.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or connected technologies in the provided documents. Symrise does not position AI as a strategic lever in its current reporting.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning or advanced automation in the report.
Innovation cited relates to product development, not digitalization or AI.
Complete absence of AI-related KPIs or initiatives.
